note: Prairie and creek-bottom woods around 157-acre Bushwhacker Lake south of Bronaugh, reached by gravel Yucca Road off 1175 Road. There are three primitive camping spots, each at a gravel loop or lot with a privy. One is a turnaround at the lake's north end, on open prairie about 60 m from a cove. Another is a large gravel lot with fire rings beside the boat ramp. The third is a wooded loop toward the south end, where generators are not allowed. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' + 'Individual Campsites', 3 mapped spots (north loop = pin, ramp lot 630 m SW, south loop 1.76 km SW); free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privies added. Lakeview kept but only from the pin's north loop (~60 m across open prairie to a cove); ramp camp and south loop have no view. South loop flagged as a split candidate. Phone matches.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, kept - marginal, from the pin's spot only), measured from each camp, not the ramp. North loop (GIS 636 = stored pin): a gravel turnaround with a privy on open prairie. Its east/southeast edge is ~60 m from the lake's north cove, measured on the 0.22 m/px leaf-off frame, across prairie grass with scattered shrubs. DEM puts the loop at 258 m against ~252 m at the cove, so the camp sits ~6 m above the water on a gentle slope. A dense shrub thicket fills the direct south line to the water, so the open line is to the ESE only. Ramp camp (GIS 303, the gravel lot with fire rings at the end of Yucca Road, on the 04/15 map's camping symbol): ~70 m to open water through the wooded bank. The only clear opening is the boat-ramp lane, which doesn't count, so this camp has no view. South loop (GIS 637): wooded on all sides, with no water within 110 m, so it isn't waterfront. If AWH reads the north loop's sightline as too thin, the value goes to not waterfront.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: south camping area, GIS 637 at 37.65951,-94.4231. It's a gravel turnaround loop with a privy under trees, 1.76 km SW of the pin. It's reached by its own gravel lane, which leaves Yucca Road near the 1175 Road end and runs down the lake's west side, so it shares the area entrance and it's borderline on the 'own road' test. The brochure singles it out: 'Generators are not allowed at the south camping area.' If split, suggested 'Bushwhacker Lake Conservation Area - South Camping Area' at ~37.6595,-94.4228, not waterfront. The ramp camp (GIS 303, 630 m from the pin) stays with this entry.

INCLUSION/FIT: the area page says 'Camping is allowed only in the designated areas' and lists Designated Camping Sites and Individual Campsites. The brochure (08/2022) says 'Primitive camping is allowed at the designated camping areas (see area map)'. The 04/15 map shows two Primitive Camping Area symbols, at the Yucca Road ramp lot and the south shore, each with a privy. GIS layer 27 adds the north loop (636). All three are on gravel area roads, with no ford, 4WD note or posted limit, and a 23-ft rig fits each loop and lot.

PIN: stored 37.67194,-94.41077 = GIS camping point 636, at north loop lot 1145 - fine. The alternative is the ramp camp (37.66793,-94.4158), which is the mapped main camping area, but it has no lake view.
PHONE: (417) 895-6880 on the area page matches.
